name: Fashion Dictator
body:
You deftly merge your occult casting with your sybarite focus.

Prerequisite(s): Sybarite focus, mesmerist level 17

Benefit(s): You can cast sybarite focus spells simultaneously as part of the same action, using the highest casting time among them. The targets for each spell cast in this way must be the same when possible. Each target attempts only one initial saving throw, if any. Its DC is that of the lowest level spell cast. On a success, the target resists all spells you’ve cast on it. In addition, you can always dismiss your focus spells, whether or not they are normally dismissable.
